notes.title: Who Shuffled My Shapes? is out now!
notes.content:
[h1]It's Release Day![/h1]

We are super excited to finally say [b]Who Shuffled My Shapes?[/b] is out now and available for purchase!

Thank you to all of you for following along on our development journey. We welcome you to now join us in the next steps of playing our game and joining our community to share your experiences. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1868060

Keep watching on our Store page to see us hold an in-house Cube competition! 


[h1]Let us know what you think[/h1]
We welcome any and all feedback, so please, any improvements or changes you think would benefit the game, let us know either here on Steam or in our [url=https://discord.gg/TqSxnCnjY6]Community Discord[/url] where we have chat rooms dedicated to Who Shufled My Shapes?


[h1]Community Scoreboard[/h1]
As a bit of ongoing fun, we are going to hold a Discord Server competition where people who share the fastest times will hold an in-server title. 

Here's one of my current fastest times!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851011/08993beb8dd5daf4aaed6eb9beba77a4b1b6e0b1.png[/img]


[h1]Who Shuffled My Shapes? V1.0 Launch Patch Notes[/h1]

To those of you who played the Demo during the Steam Next Fest - we offer you special thanks and are very grateful for your feedback!
Here is a list of all the changes made from the Demo feedback you provided!

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added new "Fast Shuffling" setting (default to off) - A commonly requested feature for those who want to get into the action a little bit faster. When enabled, the initial shuffling animation will run a lot faster.
[*] Added new "Free Movement" setting (defaulted to off) - Some more advanced players of the demo requested completely free movement of each puzzle (instead of being constrained to angles when scrolling up and down). With this setting enabled, this constraint is no longer applied.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes and Misc[/h2]
[list]
[*] When you flip a puzzle over, whether or not it has been flipped is now remembered so it will be exactly the same as you return.
[*] The stickers on the cubes have been readjusted to match the western standard color scheme.
[*] Minor bug fixes to the display settings user experience.
[*] Firework sound effects can no longer be heard in the Settings or Credits menus.
[/list]


Stay Toastie - from all of us here at ToastieLabs,
Thank you for following our development and thank you for playing our game!

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
[h1]What we've been working on[/h1]

This is it! It's release week for [b]Who Shuffled My Shapes?[/b]!

All QA testing, bug fixing and main marketing plans have been completed!

From last week we had 2 major things to fix, these were:
[list]
[*] The Windmill Cube didn't trigger complete when it was done
[*] Exiting the game with some cubes having only 1 move left would mark the save as complete, preventing you actually completing the cube without starting again
[/list]

We are happy to say both of these issues have been fixed and are ready for release!

[h2]Merch![/h2]
Just in time for release, we have had the poster for [b]Who Shuffled My Shapes?[/b] delivered so we can confirm it is good for sale!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851011/79224bf119d39572746435aa35f195ed1466f78c.jpg[/img]

Check it out on our website [url=https://www.toastielabs.co.uk/shop]here[/url] if you want to purchase your very own game merch to support us further! <3

[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
Only a tiny bit of marketing is left!

We have the final posts for the rest of the week (you may have noticed our countdown on Twitter) and we are in talks with various content creators to hopefully get some other perspectives on the game!

As well as this, we are recording and editing a (hopefully) entertaining release day broadcast video!

Make sure you add the game to your wishlist to buy the game as soon as it is released!

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
[h1]What we've been working on[/h1]

Yet another week closer to release and we are adding the final changes to [b]Who Shuffled My Shapes?[/b] 

The majority of puzzles have been completed with only 2 tricky ones left to finish! The Barrel cube and Windmill cube are all that are left to complete once I can figure out the trick!

The 2x2 Mirror cube issue reported last week has been resolved with a new 3D model and has been tested to confirm the puzzle works: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851011/e73f59ffdec8495cec6b7980c5fa6e0ccfbb24be.png[/img]

As well as this, we have spent time this week incorporating your feedback from the Next Fest Demo, these changes are:
[list]
[*] An option for unrestricted vertical rotation
[*] An option for quicker shuffling animations
[*] A updated game flow for when you complete a puzzle
[/list]

[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
Same as last week - more Marketing and more QA

We have contacted a news reporting organisation this week with hopes of getting an exclusive review - other than this we are prepped for a full marketing rollout on Friday where we will be contacting various organisations and content curators to get some potential collaborations. 

QA will continue all week to iron out as many potential bugs as possible before release. We will be hosting one last live stream on Friday before the final release day live stream on the 8th of July!

Make sure you add the game to your wishlist to keep up-to-date with the news!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1868060

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
[h1]What we've been working on[/h1]

We have had a whirlwind of a week with the Steam Next Fest! 

We spent numerous hours last week testing the game. A lot of the bug fixes previously implemented have been re-tested with most of them being marked as fixed! Only the confusing FPS setting issue remains. 

Other than this, we got many more cubes completed, now 60% of the 20 puzzles have been successfully finished - only 2 puzzles have led to things to correct.
[olist]
[*] The save file for the 3x3 Void Cube was marked as completed after closing and re-opening the game when 2 blocks weren't in the correct place
[*] The 2x2 Mirror Cube has identical pieces which leads to the puzzle looking complete when it technically isn't
[/olist]

The save file issue will take a little digging to find the cause but the 2x2 mirror cube is being corrected by slightly editing the 3D model of the blocks.


[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
In short, more QA and Marketing!

We have spent the start of this week refining our marketing plan for the build-up to release. We are prepping and/or beginning our contact with news websites and content curators so keep an eye out for potential posts about Who Shuffled My Shapes from other sources!

We have recruited some 3rd party help with QA but we will be continuing the in-house QA which we will be showcasing on Fridays Livestream - Livestream re-runs will be shown throughout the weeks in the runup to release

Make sure you add the game to your wishlist to keep up-to-date with the news!

notes.title: The Next Fest Free Demo is Live!
notes.content:
[h1]Who Shuffled My Shapes?[/h1]
Our newest game project, Who Shuffled My Shapes?, is coming out early next month!
If you can't wait to get your hands on our shapes, we have a demo that is available to play for free right now! Head over to the store page to download and play.

[b]Who Shuffled My Shapes?[/b] is a Rubik's cube-inspired game, our first step into creating puzzles in a 3D space. In order to make our game different to other digital cube games, we decided to go all-in and offer 20 different puzzles in 1 game! 
Multiple shapes and sizes are all included in this release. The Pyramix, Megaminx, mirror cubes and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851011/b19fb28935eeb11e08131f9e39dd726b4af7546a.png[/img]

So jump in and start unshuffling these shapes - With or without the added pressure of a timer to see who is the quickest!

The Free Demo will allow you to play 5 of the 20 cubes, these are:
[list]
[*] Basic 3x3 Cube
[*] Pyraminx Duo
[*] Redi Cube
[*] Kilominx
[*] Master Kilominx
[/list]
[h1]Next Fest Important Dates and Times[/h1]
The Steam Next Fest runs from now through to next Monday (13/06 to 20/06 - 10 am Pacific)
During this week hundreds of games will be sharing a demo available for you to play, this includes our game [b]Who Shuffled My Shapes?[/b] so make sure you give it a try!

As well as playing the Demo we will be very active on Steam to allow you to get in touch with us easily and ask us any questions you may have regarding the game release.

In line with this, we will be live streaming with Steam Broadcasting twice this week for you to watch us play Who Shuffled My Shapes? and chat with us live!
We will be streaming on the following dates:
[list]
[*] Tuesday the 14th at 2 pm BST (6 am PT)
[*] Friday the 17th at 3 pm BST (7 am PT)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851011/611fae4831c4d2589f35693fdb4e377b169426ce.png[/img]

Make sure you tune in to chat with us live and see us play, you can join the Live Stream directly from the Who Shuffled My Shapes? store page!

If you miss us streaming live, don't worry, we are hosting re-streams throughout the week of our past live streams. We won't be available to chat during these streams but you can still watch us play!
Look out for the "Pre-Recorded Stream" message to see if you are watching a replay or a live stream.


[h1]Wishlist now![/h1]
Now you know all about [b]Who Shuffled My Shapes?[/b] and are able to try it for yourself, make sure you head over to the store page and add it to your wishlist so you can be the first to download the game when it goes fully live on the [b]8th of July 2022[/b]!

notes.content:
[h1]Our First Broadcast![/h1]
We streamed Who Shuffled My Shapes? for the first time ever last Friday (6th May 2022) with the Steam Broadcasting feature!

There was a little bit of a learning curve for us to get things right as this was our first ever steam as an Indie Dev Studio but we feel like it went well. Thank you to the 70 of you who stopped by to have a look!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851011/1cb1092c5173e391c3b03fff92b9169baabef4f2.png[/img]

[list]

[*] Secondly - We like to be transparent with our players, we plan to use these streams to identify any issues and show off the progress we make week to week.

If you miss the streams, you can check out our weekly Dev Vlogs over on YouTube, we record most of our work during the week and upload an edited video each Friday! [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCaRcXeacWUTTXK2UAGQlEwg]https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCaRcXeacWUTTXK2UAGQlEwg[/url]

If you miss the broadcast but want to see us QA testing the game, don't worry, keep an eye on our Store Page from time to time to see when we are "live" as we are playing around with rebroadcasting the Friday streams throughout the week.

We hope to provide a full schedule at a later date.


[h1]Future Broadcasts[/h1]
We currently plan to stream every Friday around 2 PM UTC to keep up-to-date with the QA testing and update you on any changes we've made.

We have noted some issues with our first stream that we will address with future broadcasts. 
Rob has already worked on some store page assets to fill in the blank space around the stream and we know of the audio issues we had in stream 1.

Thanks again to those who stopped by for our first steam!

notes.title: Official Game Announcement!
notes.content:
We are very excited to announce our latest project! Who Shuffled My Shapes?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1868060

[h2]Who Shuffled My Shapes?[/h2]

For those of you who follow our Dev Blogs, you will know that this is a game we have been working on for a number of months now. 

Based on our love for mind-teasing puzzle toys, we wanted to create a fun project to bring our enjoyment to the digital world - As such, "Who Shuffled My Shapes?" was born!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33218193/de93f377b8847af4b1c1f14c15e9dde831c9e5b3.png[/img]

[h2]What is "Who Shuffled My Shapes?"(?) [/h2]

Who Shuffled My Shapes? is a mega-pack of 20 famous puzzle cubes (and other 3D shapes) for you to solve to keep your mind sharp!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33218193/7f57fc9e7f85518b68b783f4e9b5d92a1d70ba2e.gif[/img]

Various shapes have been shuffled and your goal is to un-shuffle them back to their original layout!

Each puzzle is unique, you will have to learn each's nuances to solve them. 

Sounds simple but it’s not. With some of the simpler puzzles offering over 43 quintillion possible configurations (that’s 43,000,000,000,000,000,000), finding the single correct one will be a challenge! If you do complete a puzzle, reshuffle it and try to beat your best time!

The puzzles aren't all cubes. We have made 20 different puzzles for you to enjoy, from the classic 6 sided cuboids, 4 sided pyrmainx, all the way to 12 sided megaminx's, non-symmetrical mirror cubes and more!


[h2]Follow Our Progress![/h2]
Who Shuffled My Shapes? is still in its infancy. Make sure you check out our Weekly Dev Vlogs on [url=https://www.youtube.com/c/ToastieLabs]YouTube[/url] as well as Wishlisting the game on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1868060]Steam[/url] to be kept up to date with all of the progress we make!

Milestone updates will be available here on our Website and on our Social Media links above.

[h3]Release Date[/h3]
We are looking to offer a Steam Demo during [b]Summer 2022[/b], an exact date will be announced closer to release. Wishlist on Steam now so you don't miss it!

[h3]Patreon[/h3]
A message to our Patreons, as promised in your tier offers, we will be releasing an early access build to our Toastie Heros a few weeks before release and a Beta Access build to our Toastie Members shortly after!

If you are not a Patreon and are interested in playing Who Shuffled My Shapes? early, take a moment to check out our [url=https://www.patreon.com/toastielabs]Patreon[/url] tiers!



if you want to get involved in all our day-to-day news make sure you join our [url=https://discord.gg/wwXVWvA]Discord[/url] and select the game emoji in the #roles channel!

Check out the Steam Store page and add it to your wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1868060
